channel.title: Trails RG Studio
channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (58)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 58

  • Style and Effects stay a preview until you tap Done
  • Only the last effect is kept
  • Auto grades the light on this device
  • Subject finds the main subject, or tells you when this Mac cannot run it
  • About and Finder now show the build number
